summary.headline: INNOSPACE amends supply contract with Hanwha Aerospace; contract value revised to KRW 480.2m
summary.what_happened: INNOSPACE Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure for its single supply contract with Hanwha Aerospace Co., Ltd. for commissioned development of a reusable-technology demonstration fluid-pneumatic umbilical. The revised contract amount is KRW 480.2m (excluding VAT), up from KRW 474.2m, with the payment schedule adjusted accordingly; the filing states the correction was made due to a change in contract amount and a revised contract was signed. The contract period runs from Dec 4, 2025 to Oct 31, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: Supply and development contracts disclosed in Korea are typically reported because their size relative to a company's revenue can affect its financial outlook and investor assessment; amendments to contract terms are disclosed so shareholders can track changes in previously announced agreements.
